datasets.title: The Natura 2000 protected areas network
datasets.purpose: To provide comprehensive spatial and descriptive data on the Natura 2000 network of protected sites across the European Union for biodiversity conservation, habitat protection, and supporting implementation of the Birds and Habitats Directives.
datasets.details: Natura 2000 is the European Union's key instrument for biodiversity protection, comprising sites designated under the Birds Directive (Special Protection Areas or SPAs) and the Habitats Directive (Sites of Community Importance or SCIs and Special Areas of Conservation or SACs). The European database is updated annually based on information submitted by Member States through site-specific standard data forms (SDFs), which provide details on designated species, habitat types, and site boundaries. The European Environment Agency (EEA) validates all submitted data and identifies inconsistencies, though final decisions on corrections remain with Member States before database updates. The dataset contains both spatial boundaries and descriptive information for each site, including the officially designated species and habitat types. The validation process is reflected in updates to the biogeographical Union Lists of Sites of Community Importance. Additional web services provide detailed information on species and habitat types within Natura 2000 sites, supporting conservation planning, environmental impact assessment, and EU environmental policy implementation.

sources.name: European Environment Agency
sources.description: Natura 2000 protected area boundaries sourced from the annual EEA Natura 2000 GIS database, compiled from national authority submissions to the European Commission (DG Environment) under the EU Birds Directive (Special Protection Areas - SPAs) and Habitats Directive (Special Areas of Conservation - SACs). GIS analysis prevents double-counting of overlapping designations. Covers all 27 EU Member States with annual updates.
